submitter: idea.uk vm site 3 (session: 085_debug_and_feature_loops) — ROUND 2, revising after REVISE
rationale: ROUND 2. Revised after the council returned REVISE (7 approve / 4 object, decided_by bug_historian). This round WIDENS the fix from one call site to the shared mechanism plus both call sites that inherit it, and corrects two concrete defects the reviewers found in round 1. What follows states the objections and what changed. THE DEFECT (unchanged). Site chrome is rendered against a HARDCODED map of template values built in Go. render_site_components_action.go:222-262 enumerates the vocabulary it will supply (company_name, logo_url, logo_text, nav_items_html, quick_links_html, cta_url, cta_text, legal_links, categories) and :530 renders the component's html_template against exactly that. input_schema appears nowhere in the file; site_components.content_data is never read. A chrome component declaring any other field name receives the empty string for every one, silently, because component_library.go:544-559 detects Go's output for missing keys, counts it, replaces it with "" and logs only a count. Live consequence on idea.uk: 30 of 34 anchors rendered href="" - entire nav, every CTA, all social links - plus . The proof of mechanism is company_name: it IS in the hardcoded map and was the ONLY chrome value that rendered. OBJECTION 1 (bug_historian, high) - 'patches ONE call site of a shared underlying mechanism while leaving the mechanism itself generic and exploitable elsewhere'. ACCEPTED, and it is the reason this round exists. Round 1 left component_library.go:544-559's blanket substitution untouched, so every OTHER renderer of a content_components.html_template against an incomplete map kept the identical silent blanking with no signal at all. Edit 3 now fixes THE MECHANISM: it determines deterministically, before execution, which bare output placeholders the template will render empty, names them, and raises severity when the blanked placeholder sits inside an href="" or src="" attribute - i.e. it distinguishes 'a word went missing' from 'a control is dead'. Every caller of RenderTemplate gains that signal, not just chrome. RenderTemplate's signature is unchanged (it becomes a thin wrapper), so no existing caller is touched. OBJECTION 2 (bug_historian, high) - the plan cites bugs_open/041 (collectJSAssets omitting site_components) as its strongest argument that this is a class, and then does not touch it, though the correct UNION already exists three files away. ACCEPTED without reservation - using an instance as evidence while leaving it broken is inconsistent. Edit 5 fixes it, mirroring the proven UNION in render_js_snippets_for_site_action.go:203-219. No signature change: collectJSAssets takes pageID, and the site is reached with (SELECT site_id FROM pages WHERE id = $1). This is live damage today - idea.uk's header and footer carry 708 and 628 bytes of js_content and reference the assets from their templates, and /tools/assets/site-header.js and site-footer.js both return 404 while a page component's asset on the same prefix returns 200. The mobile menu is dead on every page. DEFECT THE COUNCIL CAUGHT #1 (guardian, rated low - the data says it is not low). Round 1's edit 2 unmarshalled input_schema into struct{Fields map[string]map[string]interface{}}, assuming the shape {"fields":{...}}. A reviewer's own check found live components with NO fields wrapper, where the top-level keys ARE the field names. I then measured it fleet-wide: 122 components wrapped, 41 empty/null, and 8 FLAT - and critically, the FLAT one in active chrome use is 'Document Head', whose top-level keys are description, theme_css, title, and which is the head slot on 7 OF 11 SITES. Round 1 would therefore have silently no-opped on the head slot of most of the fleet - the exact silent-no-op class this submission exists to remove. Edit 2 now detects both shapes explicitly. DEFECT THE COUNCIL CAUGHT #2 (render_guardian, low - real). Round 1's gap-fill precedence was 'if s, isStr := existing.(string); !isStr || s != "" { continue }', which treats any NON-string existing value (e.g. the bool show_subscribe) as absent and falls through to resolution, so a legitimately-set non-string value could be overwritten. That is not the guarantee the rationale stated. Edit 2 now skips on presence for any non-string type and only fills when the existing value is a genuinely empty string. BLAST RADIUS - asserted in round 1, now MEASURED (guardian, medium). Six agent definitions reference this action: nav-updater, rerender-pages, site-work-orchestrator, rerender-site, nav-link-fixer, pageflow-builder. The safety argument must therefore hold across all six callers, and it does, because it rests on data precedence rather than on which pipeline is calling: schema-resolved values FILL GAPS ONLY, so wherever the hardcoded map supplies a value it stays authoritative for every caller. The nine sites on header-bold-gradient/footer-4-column declare only field names already in that map, so their output is byte-identical no matter which of the six invokes it. ACCEPTED SIDE-EFFECT, called out rather than discovered (guardian, low). sites.logo_url is empty for BOTH idea.uk and vonc.com, and header-bold-gradient declares logo_url source site_assets.logo. So vonc.com may newly render a logo image where it currently falls through to its {{else}} glyph. That is a fix, not a regression, but it is a visible change to a live site outside the stated scope and is hereby an accepted, reviewed consequence. WRITE-BACK (tooling_provenance, medium). ACCEPTED. Round 1 read PLAN_2026-07-19_cta_link_integrity.md, RUNBOOK/NOTES and link-management.md meticulously as prior decisions and wrote nothing back. Edit 6 appends the fourth call site to that plan's own enumeration and files a doc_notes entry against the cta_link_integrity pipeline, so the next reader of 'three call sites' sees four. WHAT IS STILL DELIBERATELY NOT DONE, and why. bug_historian's third objection (medium) is that edit 3 remains a log, not a gate or work item, so a genuinely unresolvable field still renders empty. Half-accepted: the severity bump on href/src context is the proportionate answer, and the log now names fields rather than counting them. I am NOT adding a work item, because bugs_open/023 established that this platform's failure mode with this class is a DELIVERY gap - 34 correctly-filed CTA findings sit unread at needs_human_review with zero consumers - so another unconsumed item type makes the invisible pile bigger. I am NOT adding a build-time gate, because 30 empty hrefs exist across 7 sites today and PLAN_2026-07-19_cta_link_integrity.md:207-211 is explicit that flipping such a check to blocking in one step fails the next rebuild of most of the fleet; the staged route (warning -> drain -> flip) is a separate piece of work with its own review. Making the anchors themselves gated is a DB-only template change, already done for idea.uk and out of this gate's scope. The two conservatism limits from round 1 are UNCHANGED and remain load-bearing: gap-fill-only, and fallbacks applied ONLY for source:static and never on a missed data-source resolution - because header-bold-gradient.cta_url is {source: pages.contact, fallback: /contact.html}, the documented fossil of the '143 of 144 buttons point at /contact.html' bug, and honouring that fallback on a miss would re-fabricate across nine live sites the exact phantom LNK-007 was deployed to remove. Leaving it unresolved is LNK-005 (correct-or-absent) by construction.

plan.summary: ROUND 2, widened after REVISE. The site-chrome renderer builds a hardcoded map of template values and never reads the component's input_schema, so chrome components declaring other field names silently receive empty strings - 30 dead href="" anchors on every page of idea.uk. Round 1 fixed only the chrome call site; bug_historian objected that this patches one call site of a shared mechanism while leaving the mechanism generic, and that the submission cited bugs_open/041 as evidence without fixing it. Both accepted. This round fixes THE MECHANISM (component_library.go's blanket <no value> blanking now names the fields it blanks and escalates severity when the blank lands inside href/src), BOTH inheriting call sites (chrome schema resolution, and collectJSAssets which omits site_components so chrome JS never publishes), and corrects two real defects the reviewers found: the {"fields":{...}} shape assumption (false for 'Document Head', the head slot on 7 of 11 sites) and a gap-fill precedence bug that could overwrite non-string values. Reuses sourceResolver and the proven UNION; no new resolver, no new work-item type, no signature changes.

edits.rationale: The component's declared schema is never loaded, so it cannot be honoured. Both SELECTs that fetch the template - the assigned-component query (:489-494) and the default-component fallback (:507-512) - must also return input_schema. This edit alone changes no rendering behaviour; it makes the schema available to edit 2.
edits.sketch:
@@ renderAndStoreSiteComponent (~:486)
 	var componentID uuid.UUID
 	var htmlTemplate string
+	var inputSchemaRaw []byte
 
 	err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
-		SELECT sc.component_id, cc.html_template
+		SELECT sc.component_id, cc.html_template, COALESCE(cc.input_schema, '{}'::jsonb)
 		FROM site_components sc
 		JOIN content_components cc ON sc.component_id = cc.id
 		WHERE sc.site_id = $1 AND sc.slot_name = $2
-	`, siteID, slot).Scan(&componentID, &htmlTemplate)
+	`, siteID, slot).Scan(&componentID, &htmlTemplate, &inputSchemaRaw)
 
 	if err != nil {
 		/* slotToFunction default lookup, unchanged */
 		err = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `
-			SELECT id, html_template
+			SELECT id, html_template, COALESCE(input_schema, '{}'::jsonb)
 			FROM content_components
 			WHERE function = $1
 			ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
-		`, funcName).Scan(&componentID, &htmlTemplate)
+		`, funcName).Scan(&componentID, &htmlTemplate, &inputSchemaRaw)
 	}

edits.rationale: THE FIX, corrected on two counts the council found. Resolve the schema's declared fields through the EXISTING sourceResolver (plan_sections_action.go:65-475, same package, zero new resolution code); it already handles site_specs.*, site_assets.* incl. the image-role alias, pages.* and config.*, and already refuses to fabricate a URL on a pages.* miss (:449-453 calls that 'the phantom-link generator'). newSourceResolver's doc-comment states an empty pageName 'degrades safely' - exactly the site-wide chrome case. CORRECTION 1 (guardian; under-rated as low, the data says otherwise): input_schema has TWO live shapes. Measured fleet-wide: 122 wrapped {"fields":{...}}, 41 empty/null, 8 FLAT with field names at top level - and the FLAT one in active chrome use is 'Document Head' (keys description, theme_css, title), the head slot on 7 OF 11 SITES. Round 1's unmarshal would have yielded an empty map with NO error for those, silently doing nothing. Both shapes are now detected. CORRECTION 2 (render_guardian): the gap-fill check treated any non-string existing value as absent, so a set bool like show_subscribe could be overwritten. Presence now wins for every non-string type; only a genuinely empty string is filled. The two limits are unchanged and load-bearing: GAP-FILL ONLY (so LNK-007's resolved cta_url and GetNavItems legal links stay authoritative, and the nine sites on header-bold-gradient/footer-4-column render byte-identically under all six calling pipelines), and FALLBACKS ONLY FOR source:static, never on a missed data-source resolution (header-bold-gradient.cta_url's fallback is /contact.html, the fossil of the phantom-CTA bug LNK-007 fixed).

THE MECHANISM FIX — this is what bug_historian's high objection asked for, and it is the difference between round 1 and round 2. Today :552-559 detects Go's <no value> output, counts it, blanks it and logs a count plus a 100-char template preview. That is why 30 dead controls shipped on a live public site for months with no actionable signal, and it applies to EVERY caller of RenderTemplate, not just chrome — round 1 left it untouched, which is exactly the 'patches one call site, leaves the mechanism generic' pattern the council named. Fix it at the mechanism: determine BEFORE execution which bare output placeholders the template will render empty, by scanning for {{.Name}} and testing the data map. This is deterministic and does not depend on the <no value> string at all. Two deliberate refinements. (a) Only BARE OUTPUT placeholders are reported: a name missing inside {{if .x}} or {{range .x}} is correct gating, not a defect, and reporting it would make the signal noise. (b) Severity escalates to Error when the blanked placeholder sits inside href="" or src="" — that is the difference between a missing word and a dead control, and it answers the 'a warn nobody watches' half of the objection proportionately without adding a gate that would fail the next rebuild of most of the fleet. RenderTemplate's SIGNATURE IS UNCHANGED: it becomes a thin wrapper over a new sibling that also returns the missing names, so no existing caller is edited and chrome (edit 4) can consume the list.

Chrome consumes the mechanism's new signal and adds what only it knows: the slot, the component and the site. Round 1's edit 3 logged only the schema fields it failed to resolve; that missed any placeholder the template uses which the schema never declared — and idea.uk's templates were full of those. Combining the two lists gives the operator the exact set of names to gate. Deliberately a log and not a work item: bugs_open/023 established the failure mode here is a DELIVERY gap (34 correctly-filed CTA findings sit unread at needs_human_review with zero consumers), so another unconsumed item type enlarges the invisible pile. The severity distinction now comes from the mechanism, so a dead chrome control logs at Error with its field names — the thing that was missing when 30 of them shipped.

edits.rationale: bugs_open/041, the second instance this submission cited as evidence and round 1 failed to fix — bug_historian's objection, accepted. collectJSAssets is the ONLY thing that publishes /tools/assets/{function}.js and it reads page_components only, so a site component's js_content is never published. Live damage: idea.uk's header and footer carry 708 and 628 bytes of js_content AND reference the assets from their templates, yet /tools/assets/site-header.js and site-footer.js both return 404 while /tools/assets/latest-news.js (a page component, same prefix) returns 200 — the hamburger renders, has aria-expanded, and does nothing on every page. The fix is not invented: render_js_snippets_for_site_action.go:203-219 already UNIONs page_components and site_components for the snippets bundle, so the two JS paths currently disagree about whether chrome exists. Mirror the proven query. NO SIGNATURE CHANGE — collectJSAssets takes pageID, and the owning site is reached with a scalar subquery, so no caller is touched.
edits.sketch:
@@ collectJSAssets (:155-162)
 	rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, `
 		SELECT DISTINCT cc.function, cc.js_content
 		FROM page_components pc
 		JOIN content_components cc ON pc.component_id = cc.id
 		WHERE pc.page_id = $1
 		  AND cc.js_content IS NOT NULL
 		  AND cc.js_content != ''
+		UNION
+		-- Chrome (header/footer/head) is reached only through site_components, so
+		-- its js_content was never published and its <script src> always 404'd
+		-- (bugs_open/041). Mirrors the UNION already used by
+		-- render_js_snippets_for_site_action.go:203-219 for the snippets bundle.
+		SELECT DISTINCT cc.function, cc.js_content
+		FROM site_components sc
+		JOIN content_components cc ON sc.component_id = cc.id
+		WHERE sc.site_id = (SELECT site_id FROM pages WHERE id = $1)
+		  AND cc.js_content IS NOT NULL
+		  AND cc.js_content != ''
 	`, pageID)

plan.risks: 1) BLAST RADIUS IS NOW MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED (guardian's objection). Six agent definitions invoke this action: nav-updater, rerender-pages, site-work-orchestrator, rerender-site, nav-link-fixer, pageflow-builder. The byte-identical argument holds across all six because it rests on DATA PRECEDENCE, not on the caller: gap-fill-only means a schema value is written only where ContentData has no key or holds an empty string, and the nine sites on header-bold-gradient/footer-4-column declare only names already in that map. A reviewer should check that precedence branch, since it is the entire safety argument. 2) THE FALLBACK RULE IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC. If a future revision 'simplifies' edit 2 by applying def["fallback"] on a MISSED resolution, header-bold-gradient.cta_url re-fabricates /contact.html across nine live sites and re-opens LNK-007. Any edit touching that branch must be checked against the fossil quote in grounded_in. 3) ACCEPTED VISIBLE CHANGE TO A SITE OUTSIDE SCOPE: sites.logo_url is empty for vonc.com as well as idea.uk, and header-bold-gradient declares logo_url source site_assets.logo, so vonc.com may newly render a logo image where it currently shows its {{else}} glyph. Reviewed and accepted rather than discovered post-deploy. 4) EDIT 3 CHANGES A FUNCTION EVERY RENDERER USES. RenderTemplate's signature is deliberately unchanged (thin wrapper) so no caller is edited, but the LOGGING behaviour changes fleet-wide: some templates will now log at Error where they previously logged a Warn count. That is the intent, but it will be visible in log volume immediately, and a reviewer should confirm the bare-output-only rule (names inside {{if}}/{{range}} are NOT reported) is correctly implemented — otherwise every gated template in the library logs on every render. 5) THE REGEX IS A HEURISTIC. missingBareFields recognises {{.Name}} only; it will not see {{ .Name | safe }}, {{index .m "k"}} or nested field paths. That is deliberate — under-reporting is safe (status quo), over-reporting is noise — but it means the signal is not a guarantee of completeness and should not be treated as one. 6) COLLECTJSASSETS NOW PUBLISHES MORE FILES. Any site whose chrome components carry js_content will begin emitting /tools/assets/{function}.js where it previously emitted nothing. Measured today only idea.uk has such components (708 + 628 bytes), so the immediate delta is two files on one site; the function-name collision risk is the same one sql/p2_02 documents (function defaults to generic-text-block would collide) and is unchanged by this edit. 7) INPUT_SCHEMA SHAPE: both wrapped and FLAT are now handled, and a schema that is neither (a scalar under a field key) is skipped rather than erroring. Malformed JSON falls through to existing behaviour — a site that renders fine today cannot be broken by an unparseable schema. 8) ORDERING: Go change, inert until a chassis image is rebuilt and rolled; per the 098 precedent the image must be live in-pod BEFORE any accompanying schema/seed change. Verify against the pod, not the tag. 9) NO TEST EXISTS for render_site_components_action.go or for the blanking path. A reviewer may reasonably require tests for missingBareFields (bare vs gated placeholder, href/src context) and for the gap-fill precedence including the non-string case — those two branches are where both round-1 defects lived.
